[Cache the gRNA precomputation on the sceptre_object](https://github.com/Katsevich-Lab/sceptre/pull/233)
by Eugenio Mattei (`emattei`). Inspected using authenticated `gh` on 2026-10-19:
body, actual diff, review and all three inline review comments. Head:
`3f1ff0650078b382662ee70b72ea5c72fa15b031`; base:
`21f9ea098b69c444a884a49bc254de711968e3b5`. Snapshots are in `references/`.
This is source inspection, not a merge or adoption of its old slot architecture.

Adopted principles:

- Cache the deterministic CRT treatment-membership model, independently of
  response fits; keep resampling draws fresh on every invocation.
- Retain compact coefficients rather than a probability vector per guide.
  Reconstruct with the same binomial inverse-link and unnamed ordered matrix
  product, preserving clipping and floating-point behavior.
- Recognize distinct complement and treatment-plus-NT fitting selections.
- Clear perturbation models on reassignment at either MOI while preserving the
  existing response-cache invalidation policy.
- Calibration bypasses the perturbation cache and retains existing discovery
  entries. Actual fitting warnings occur on cold fits; warm reconstruction does
  not replay them, but retains their messages and diagnostics in the entry.

Adaptations to the current component model and Eugene's review:

- One `FitCache` owns separately valid response and perturbation families.
  No new flat top-level gRNA-precomputation slot or saved execution mode.
- A shared analysis context stores ordered cells once. Each guide entry stores
  hashes of actual ordered fit cells, actual design and binary treatment
  membership; it never copies common NT-cell indices or cell-length predictions.
  Design values, not only column names, participate in validity.
- Reconstructability is checked against the first original `glm.fit` result
  before a model is admitted. Aliased/nonfinite or nonidentical cases use those
  original probabilities and decline caching. No second regression is run just
  to obtain the fallback probabilities.
- Worker proposals are merged only after all workers finish; the public
  coordinator returns fit updates only after successful result finalization.
- Tests assert actual low-MOI NT mode, cold/warm numerical and RNG equality,
  incompatible-context rejection, independent invalidation and failed-run
  preservation. This addresses the earlier fixture that forced complement mode.
